parts.question_text:
A ball is projected with a horizontal velocity of 1.1 m s^{-1} from point A at the edge of a table, as
shown in Fig. 1.2.
The ball lands on horizontal ground at point B which is a distance of 0.43 m from the base of
the table. Air resistance is negligible.
